title: Hard to Translate, Harder to Detect: Human Analysis Remains Essential in AI Meme Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.30710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a dataset and evaluation setup for a problem in creative machine translation: translating culturally loaded passages that carry much of a text's meaning and humor that may depend on subtle or implicit discourse. We study Soviet comedy quotations that function as memes in Russian-language communication. Off-the-shelf difficulty estimators do not find these passages; current models searching the web find most but not all of them, but their own analyses of the difficulty do not help translation as well as a human-validated one. Given a brief human-validated analysis of why each passage is difficult, older models improve modestly; the strongest current translators (GPT-6 Sol and Claude Opus 5.5) improve more, and in human evaluation GPT-6 Sol comes close to the approved references on most films. Newer models have thus become much better at using such an analysis while still not reliably producing it themselves. We release (1) a da

translated_title: 《难翻译，更难识别：人工分析在AI迷因翻译中依然不可或缺》
translated_abstract: 我们针对创意机器翻译中的一类问题——翻译承载文本大量含义与幽默、且可能依赖于微妙或隐含语篇的文化负载段落——提出了一个数据集与评估方案。我们研究了在俄语交流中作为迷因（meme）使用的苏联喜剧台词。现成的难度估计器无法识别出这些段落；当前通过搜索网络的模型能找到其中大部分（但并非全部），但模型自身对难度的分析对翻译的帮助不如经过人工验证的分析。在提供简短的、经人工验证的关于每个段落为何困难的解析之后，较旧的模型仅有适度提升；而目前最强的翻译模型（GPT-6 Sol 和 Claude Opus 5.5）提升更为显著，在人工评估中，GPT-6 Sol 在大多数影片上已接近经过认可的参考译文。因此，较新的模型在使用此类分析方面已有长足进步，但仍然无法可靠地自行生成这些分析。我们发布了（1）一个数据集……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了基于苏联喜剧迷因台词的文化负载文本翻译数据集与评估体系，证明人工验证的难度分析仍是提升AI迷因翻译质量的关键，因为即使是最强的模型也无法可靠地自行生成这类分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a dataset and evaluation setup for translating culturally loaded Soviet comedy meme quotations, demonstrating that human-validated difficulty analysis remains essential for AI meme translation, as even the strongest current models cannot reliably produce such analyses themselves.
